About me

Hi, I'm Daniela.

I'm an accounting student at CUNY Lehman College in the Bronx, graduating in May 2027, with a minor in Blockchain & Cryptocurrency. I've interned in tax at PwC and Citrin Cooperman, where I worked on tax provision, individual returns, and automating data-heavy workpapers.

Outside the classroom I serve as president of the NABA chapter at Lehman, and I was a Student Ambassador for the New York Jobs CEO Council, creating digital media to engage students.

What drives me? Being able to be a part of the generation of change.

In the news

Featured by Lehman College

Lehman College News · September 21, 2026

School of Business Spotlight: Daniela Loveridge

Lehman's School of Business profiled my path into accounting, from the ACE Program and ALPFA to four internships and the presidency of the NABA chapter.

  • I chose accounting because it keeps options open: every firm needs accountants.
  • ALPFA, which I joined freshman year, taught me why networking matters in this field.
  • A rotational internship at Lincoln Hospital through the LEARN Program took me through capital planning, marketing, finance, and food nutrition.
  • My advice to students: get to know professors and deans, build relationships with peers, and get involved on campus, because a closed mouth doesn't get fed.
